history.text: The Aksumite empire minted its own coinage and adopted Christianity in the 4th century.
The rock-hewn churches of Lalibela were cut from living stone.
Ethiopian forces defeated Italy at Adwa, preserving independence.
Italian occupation interrupted sovereignty until liberation.
The Derg deposed Haile Selassie and installed a military government.
The Derg fell; a federal constitution followed in 1995.

worthSeeing.title: Lalibela:
worthSeeing.text: Eleven monolithic rock-hewn churches, still an active pilgrimage site.

worthSeeing.title: Simien Mountains:
worthSeeing.text: Escarpments and gelada troops above 4,000 m, a UNESCO site.

worthSeeing.title: Danakil Depression:
worthSeeing.text: Sulphur springs and salt flats in one of the hottest places on earth.
